decisions.reason: The aloe vera line was launched only in 2023 and has its own page, so its prospects are still uncertain and promising, and the firm's in-house small-batch production keeps the cost of holding this option open low.
A hyaluronic acid serum fits a strong category in natural facial care, and one year of results reveals too little to justify abandonment while carrying it costs little in a small-batch range.
A cleansing milk is a basic complement to the facial care range and is cheap to keep, and the evidence so far gives no sign that its value will not be realized.
